verification.command: approved architecture, Phase 3 closure evidence and current PostgreSQL reader review
verification.summary: The plan preserves mutable sync tables as staging, introduces one pure release policy boundary before persistence, and keeps public observed-only, baseline-empty, PostgreSQL-only and Catalyst fail-closed contracts unchanged.

Five bounded Slices define exact schema ownership, legacy import, 40-spec shadow proof, atomic pointer cutover, scheduled candidate-first refresh, rollback and per-Slice candidate gates without implementing Phase 5 or Phase 6 early.

risks.detail: Every active request must read one manifest and scope Gear and Community rows to its exact release IDs; missing or mixed bindings fail closed.
legacy-import-r0 describes provenance only; every candidate must re-pass the current Resolver against the candidate Gear Release.
Shadow and election gates preserve real-player observed-only winners and public baseline zero; illegal rows remain rejected/internal.
Promotion and rollback compare-and-swap the active pointer; immutable content is not rewritten or deleted.

summary: Slice 4A is planned and implementation-allowed only after the Phase 3 closure PR lands. No production module, schema, release write, shadow read or active manifest behavior has been implemented or claimed.
